item.title: Federal Way, WA light rail extension officially opens to public
item.description: Two years overdue, but with excited community fanfare, the Federal Way extension of Sound Transit's light rail officially opened on Saturday.

item.title: WA high school bus involved in deadly crash, wresting team safe
item.description: One person is dead after a vehicle crashed into a school bus carrying a Washington high school's wresting team on Saturday.

item.title: Seattle Weather: Rounds of Rain On the Way
item.description: We are gearing up for days of rain beginning on Monday. Winds will be gusty at times as the atmospheric river sets up. Slightly drier days are forecast for next weekend.

item.title: Seattle Kraken lose 4-3 to Red Wings on late Patrick Kane goal
item.description: Patrick Kane scored the tiebreaking goal with 2:29 remaining in the third period and the Detroit Red Wings beat the Seattle Kraken 4-3 on Saturday night.

item.title: 14-year-old shot in Tacoma, WA car on Friday dies in hospital
item.description: Tacoma police are investigating after a 14-year-old boy was found shot in a car and later died in the hospital over the weekend.

item.title: Seattle weather: Flooding ahead with atmospheric rivers
item.description: Bottom line: there are four consecutive Weather Alert Days from tomorrow (Monday) to Thursday. There will be moderate river flooding, isolated major flooding, with the worst of it on Tuesday.

item.title: Rashid Shaheed scores 100-yard kickoff return TD and Seattle Seahawks blow away Falcons 37-9
item.description: Rashid Shaheed returned the second-half kickoff 100 yards for a touchdown, Seattle's defense came up with three turnovers and the Seahawks beat the hapless Atlanta Falcons 37-9 on Sunday.

item.title: Takeaways from Seattle Seahawks 37-9 win over Falcons
item.description: A dominant second half performance kick-started by a 100-yard kickoff return touchdown by Rashid Shaheed carried the Seattle Seahawks to a 37-9 blowout win over the Atlanta Falcons on Sunday.

item.title: Seattle Weather: Heavy Rain and Gusty Winds on Monday
item.description: The FOX13 Weather Team has issued Weather Alerts for Monday-Thursday as a strong atmospheric river arrives with heavy rain and gusty winds. Rain will decrease some by next weekend.

item.title: Commentary: World Cup “Pride Match” featuring Egypt and Iran an intriguing situation for local organizing
item.description: The World Cup match in Seattle, now featuring Egypt and Iran on June 26, had been designated the "Pride Match" to kickoff Pride Weekend and unite the soccer and LGBTQ+ communities.
